mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members ( email, password, nickname, provider, provider_id, role ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{role} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password, nickname, provider, provider_id, role, created_at, updated_at FROM members WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, email, password, nickname, provider, provider_id, role, created_at, updated_at FROM members WHERE id = #{id}
